The structure of ScAlCu crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Sc₄Al₄Cu₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Al and Cu center has 12 geometric neighbors (6 Al/Cu and 6 Sc), while each Sc center has 12 neighbors (6 Al and 6 Cu), all at distances of 2.84–2.95 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al and Cu 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing observed between Al and Sc polyhedra.
